title: The Lower Central Series of Right Lower-Triangular Nielsen Automorphism Groups
summary: Let $F_n$ be a free group of rank $n\geq3$, freely generated by $x_1,\ldots,x_n$. For $1\leq j<i\leq n$, let $d_{i,j}$ denote the Nielsen automorphism of $F_n$ defined by $d_{i,j}(x_i)=x_ix_j$ and $d_{i,j}(x_k)=x_k$ for $k\neq i$, and let $D_n=\langle d_{i,j}\mid 1\leq j<i\leq n\rangle$. We determine the lower central series of $D_n$. We first prove that, for $1\leq r<i\leq n$, $d_{i,r}\in γ_{i-r}(D_n)\setminusγ_{i-r+1}(D_n)$.
